name: Portainer
description: Full web dashboard for Docker: containers, images, volumes, networks. (Your Homepage already links to it.)
notes: Create the admin account within 5 minutes of installing, or Portainer locks itself until restarted.
compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:lts
    container_name: portainer
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:9000"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - {DATA}:/data
